description.description: A series of three frames showing an ambulance on a highway with its rear doors open. In the first frame, a medical stretcher with a patient on it has just exited the back of the moving ambulance. In the second frame, the ambulance continues to drive away as the stretcher rolls independently behind it on the asphalt. The third frame shows only the stretcher and patient rolling down the highway as the ambulance has moved further ahead out of the primary focus. All frames include a news-style text overlay at the bottom.
description.ocrText: PATIENT FALLS OUT OF MOVING AMBULANCE WITH STRETCHER DRIVER UNAWARE, VIDEO GOES VIRAL
